entities.name: Ivana Bramborová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivana Bramborová is a Slovak female former volleyball player, playing as an outside-spiker. She was part of the Slovakia women's national volleyball team. She competed at the 2009 Women's European Volleyball Championship.
